name: Sibeon
title: Horite and descendant of Seir
summary: Sibeon was a Horite chieftain and descendant of Seir who lived in the region of Edom. He is mentioned in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as the father of Anah, known for his son Anah discovering hot springs in the desert while grazing donkeys. Sibeon belonged to the original people of the Seir mountains before Esau's descendants settled there.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as son of Seir
keyEvents.description: Sibeon is listed as one of Seir's sons, the original Horite inhabitants in the Edom region.

keyEvents.title: Sibeon's children mentioned
keyEvents.description: Sibeon's sons Aja and Ana are listed among the Horite clans in the land of Seir.

keyEvents.title: Sibeon as a Horite chieftain
keyEvents.description: Sibeon is mentioned as one of the Horite chieftains who ruled in the land of Seir, in the list of Seir's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Ana finds hot springs
keyEvents.description: Sibeon's son Ana found the hot springs in the wilderness while grazing his father Sibeon's donkeys, a remarkable event preserved in genealogical records.

keyEvents.title: Genealogy repeated in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Sibeon's lineage and his place among Seir's sons are repeated in 1 Chronicles as part of Edom's history.
